raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fuse the `o_proj` per-token FP8 input quant into the MLA `W_UV` BMM. The fusion is handled by `MLAAttnQuantFusionPass` and only activates on ROCm with AITER enabled.

For decode, AITER fuses the per-token FP8 quant into the reduce step of the BMM.

Depends on https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6727.

## Claims

- gsm8k accuracy is unchanged.
- Per decode step and layer: the W_UV BMM + separate per-token quant kernel are replaced by a split-K BMM whose reduce step also does the per-token FP8 quant.

## Validation

### Commands

```bash
# serve
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
export VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_SKINNY_GEMM=0
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP8BMM=1

vllm serve $MODEL \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
  --dtype auto \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --disable-uvicorn-access-log \
  --max-model-len 32768 \
  --max-num-seqs 512 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  -cc.use_inductor_graph_partition=True \
  -cc.pass_config.fuse_rope_kvcache_cat_mla=True \
  -cc.pass_config.fuse_attn_quant=True

# bench
vllm bench serve \
  --model $MODEL \
  --backend vllm \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --base-url http://localhost:8000 \
  --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len 1024 \
  --random-output-len 1024 \
  --num-prompts $((CONC * 10)) \
  --max-concurrency $CONC \
  --request-rate inf \
  --ignore-eos \
  --percentile-metrics "ttft,tpot,itl,e2el" \
  --save-result

# accuracy
lm_eval \
  --model local-completions \
  --model_args "model=$MODEL,base_url=http://localhost:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,max_retries=3,tokenized_requests=False,tokenizer_backend=None,trust_remote_code=True" \
  --tasks gsm8k \
  --num_fewshot 20 \
  --seed 42
```

### Benchmarks

| Concurrency | Output token throughput before (tok/s) | Output token throughput after (tok/s) | Speedup | Median TTFT before (ms) | Median TTFT after (ms) | Speedup | Median TPOT before (ms) | Median TPOT after (ms) | Speedup |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 16 | 1565.40 | 1578.40 | 1.008x | 242.10 | 244.98 | 0.988x | 9.99 | 9.88 | 1.011x |
| 64 | 4292.99 | 4339.18 | 1.011x | 360.28 | 308.78 | 1.167x | 14.60 | 14.46 | 1.010x |
| 128 | 6990.36 | 7072.38 | 1.012x | 373.97 | 435.59 | 0.859x | 17.95 | 17.69 | 1.014x |

### Accuracy

Before:

|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|    20|exact_match|↑  |0.9492|±  |0.0060|
|     |       |strict-match    |    20|exact_match|↑  |0.9447|±  |0.0063|

After:

|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|    20|exact_match|↑  |0.9538|±  |0.0058|
|     |       |strict-match    |    20|exact_match|↑  |0.9522|±  |0.0059|

## Details

- Requirements:
  - `-cc.pass_config.fuse_attn_quant=True`, which needs `use_inductor_graph_partition=True`.
  - `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP8BMM=1`.
- Not a duplicate:
  - #59856 and #36297 cover static per-tensor quant on NVIDIA.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

+class MLAAttnFp8DynamicTokenQuantPattern(

+    """Fusion for MLA Attention+Fp8DynamicTokenQuant (per-token dynamic FP8).

+    Matches the pattern: MLA attention -> per_token_quant, and
+    replaces it with MLA attention(output_block_scale=token_scale_buffer).

+        )
